content.short: Volo is a leading liquid staking protocol on Sui that optimizes yield and capital efficiency via vSUI.
content.description:
Volo is a premier decentralized liquid staking protocol built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide users with a highly liquid and yield-bearing version of their staked assets. By allowing participants to stake SUI tokens and receive vSUI (or voloSUI) in return, the platform enables them to earn network staking rewards while maintaining total capital liquidity. This ensures that users can deploy their vSUI across other DeFi protocols—such as lending markets and liquidity pools—to maximize their overall returns.

Deeply integrated with the Sui ecosystem, Volo serves as a vital infrastructure layer that standardizes staking and expands the utility of digital assets. The protocol focuses on professional-grade risk management and transparent on-chain execution, providing a seamless user experience typical of centralized finance. Through its commitment to innovation and community-driven growth, Volo is empowering the next generation of DeFi participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios within the Sui network.
